prompt_text: Write a Python solution for the HackerRank problem Triplets.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The brute-force solution counts index-based triplets instead of distinct value-based triplets, leading to overcounting when duplicate values exist.
bug_analysis.root_cause: Does not eliminate duplicate value combinations and treats repeated values as separate triplets.

test_failures.details: Counts duplicate triplets due to repeated values

improvement_strategy.improved_prompt: Ensure counting of distinct triplets by removing duplicates or using combinational logic on unique values.
improvement_strategy.improvements_made: Need to deduplicate input before counting or use combination formula
